map.on weight of fibre/fabric 的缩写，表示染料或助剂用量相: It stands for "on weight of fibre/fabric", meaning the percentage of dye or auxiliary relative to the dry weight of the fabric, and it is the most common dosing basis in dyeing and printing.

map.实际用量 = 标准用量 ÷ 力份(%)。力份 100% 按标称，力份 80% 则: Actual usage = standard usage ÷ strength (%). At 100% strength use the nominal figure; at 80% strength multiply the usage by 1/0.8, so the tool should support a strength correction or you should convert it yourself.

map.浴比决定染液量与浓度，影响得色深度与匀染性；小浴比省水节能但匀染难度上升，需配合: The liquor ratio determines the bath volume and concentration, which affect the shade depth and levelling; a small liquor ratio saves water and energy but makes levelling harder, so it needs matching auxiliaries and equipment.

map.：织物 1000 g、染色深度 3% o.w.f、浴比 1:10 → 染料用量: : fabric 1000 g, shade 3% o.w.f, liquor ratio 1:10 -> dye 30 g; total bath 1000x10=10000 mL (10 L), bath concentration 30 g/10 L = 3 g/L.
